# 🚀 Repository Release Checklist

- [ ] README reflects the current repository.
- [ ] All assignment HTML files remain present.
- [ ] Existing screenshots remain present.
- [ ] Documentation links pass.
- [ ] HTML validation results are recorded.
- [ ] SVG assets validate.
- [ ] No credentials/private information were added.
- [ ] License and third-party notices are present.
- [ ] GitHub Actions results are inspected.
- [ ] Known limitations remain documented.
